entry.headline: Tell us what you're looking for. We'll take it from there.
entry.subhead: You don't need to know which program you need. A few thoughtful questions will help us identify the right place to begin.

gateway.question: Do you already know what you're looking for?
What would you most like support with right now?

foundation_elimination.question: Are you specifically looking for the direct CellCore route, or practitioner-guided foundational support?

women_elimination.question: Which is closest to your current goal?

CELLULAR_CLEANSE.title: Cellular Cleanse
CELLULAR_CLEANSE.description: A practitioner-guided foundational pathway for those who want to begin with a structured cellular-support approach. Your starting assessment establishes the foundation for review; when this pathway is appropriate, the practitioner determines the appropriate next step and coordinates the relevant protocol and resources. This is a complimentary starting pathway, not a retail product bundle.
CELLULAR_CLEANSE.invite_subject: Your Cellular Cleanse pathway is ready

POMEGRANATE.title: Pomegranate — Whole-Woman Foundations
POMEGRANATE.description: A premium whole-woman wellness pathway designed to bring nutrition, daily rhythms, vitality, reproductive wellness, and life-stage considerations into one coherent strategy. Your targeted intake is reviewed personally, then your next step is selected from the appropriate pathway when indicated.

MENOPAUSE_CORE.title: Menopause Core
MENOPAUSE_CORE.description: A curated entry into Menopause Core for women navigating perimenopause, menopause, or the years beyond. Your experience begins with a focused assessment and pattern review, then moves into a prioritized strategy built around your actual priorities.
MENOPAUSE_CORE.invite_subject: Your Menopause Core pathway is ready

OVO.title: OVO — Fertility & Preparation Pathway
OVO.description: A preparation-for-life and fertility pathway for women, men, or couples who want to create a stronger foundation before or alongside their family-building journey. Female, male, and couple pathways remain individually routed.

OYSTER.title: Oyster — Men's Vitality
OYSTER.description: A precision wellness pathway for men focused on vitality, performance, recovery, body composition, sleep, longevity, and—when relevant—fertility.
OYSTER.invite_subject: Your Precision Vitality Pathway is ready

VIBRANT_PETS.title: Vibrant Pets
VIBRANT_PETS.description: A personalized companion-animal nutrition and wellness pathway grounded in individual species, life stage, feeding pattern, lifestyle, and goals.
VIBRANT_PETS.invite_subject: Your Companion’s Wellness Pathway is ready

HEALTHIER_TOGETHER.title: Healthier Together — Household Wellness
HEALTHIER_TOGETHER.description: A coordinated household wellness pathway built around the reality that health happens inside the home, while each person and pet remains individually routed according to their own needs.
HEALTHIER_TOGETHER.invite_subject: Your Household Wellness Pathway is ready
